title: Find a tenant
description: Go from the dashboard to a tenant's profile (spans two pages).

steps.title: Find a tenant
steps.text: Let's find a tenant's profile, starting from the side menu.

steps.title: Open Tenants
steps.text: Tenants are under People in the side menu.

steps.title: Search the list
steps.text: Type part of a name, email, or phone number to find who you're looking for.

steps.title: Open a profile
steps.text: Click any row to open that tenant's profile: lease, balance, payments, and messages in one place.
